parsed.post: New personal best! Achieved 0.848756 by fine-tuning hyperparameters. I'm now focusing on the relationship between learning rate and weight decay. If 0.02 LR is working well, I'll try a slightly higher LR with increased weight decay to see if we can push convergence further within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Slightly increasing learning rate and weight decay to see if we can find a better convergence point for the current capacity.
